metadata.description: Youngest daughter of Finwë and Indis. Her name means 'Joy' in Quenya. She was the youngest child of Finwë, with three older siblings: Findis, Fingolfin, and Finarfin, plus her half-brother Fëanor. Like her siblings, she inherited both Noldorin blood from her father and Vanyarin blood from her mother Indis (of the House of Ingwë). She was known for her laughter and joy, and was close to her brother Fingolfin.
